findings.title: Transfer is no longer atomic: a failure after the debit loses money
findings.description: The try/catch that saved both balances and restored them on error was removed. If anything throws between the debit and the credit (here hooks.afterDebit, in production any I/O or validation failure), the source account stays debited and the destination is never credited.
findings.impact: Money disappears on partial failure and balances become inconsistent; the idempotency key is not stored either, so a retry debits again.
findings.recommendation: Restore the snapshot of both balances and the catch block that rolls them back before rethrowing.

findings.description: The atomicity test injects a failure between debit and credit and expects both balances unchanged. This PR removes exactly that behaviour without touching tests.
